legal.title: Legal Notice
legal.intro: In compliance with the duty of information set out in Article 10 of Spanish Law 34/2002, of 11 July, on Information Society Services and Electronic Commerce (LSSICE), the following details are provided below:

This website provides information about the rural house, its services and availability, but this never constitutes an automatic contract or booking: every booking is confirmed directly by email or phone.

The user agrees to make appropriate and lawful use of the website, as well as of the content and services offered on it, in accordance with current legislation, good faith, public order and this Legal Notice.

Its reproduction, distribution, public communication or transformation, in whole or in part, without the express authorisation of the owner, is prohibited.
legal.section.5.title: 5. Liability and external links

The owner assumes no responsibility for the content, availability or privacy policies of such external sites.
legal.section.6.title: 6. Data protection

Any personal data you provide through the contact email or phone number will be processed in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Spanish Organic Law 3/2018 on Personal Data Protection and the guarantee of digital rights (LOPDGDD), for the sole purpose of attending to your request for information or booking.

You can exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction and portability by writing to the contact email indicated in section 1.

meta.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
meta.privacy.description: Privacy policy for Casa Rural Valle de Arbas: what data we process, for what purpose and how to exercise your rights.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Casa Rural Valle de Arbas we respect your privacy. Here we explain what personal data we process when you visit this website or contact us, for what purpose, and what rights you have.
privacy.section.1.title: 1. Data controller
privacy.section.1.body: The data controller is the owner indicated in the Legal Notice, with the following contact details:
privacy.section.2.title: 2. What data we process and why
privacy.section.2.body:
This website has no forms and does not automatically collect personal data. The only personal data we process is what you voluntarily provide when contacting us by email, phone or WhatsApp (name, email, phone number and details of your stay), for the sole purpose of responding to your enquiry and managing your booking.

The website stores your preferred language in the browser's local storage (localStorage) to remember it on your next visit; this data never leaves your device, is not a cookie, and does not identify any person.
privacy.section.3.title: 3. Legal basis
privacy.section.3.body: The legal basis for processing your contact details is your own consent when writing to us, and the performance of pre-contractual or contractual measures necessary to manage your booking (Articles 6.1.a and 6.1.b of the GDPR).
privacy.section.4.title: 4. Data retention
privacy.section.4.body: We keep your data for as long as the relationship arising from your enquiry or booking lasts, and afterwards for the legally required periods (for example, tax obligations), after which it is deleted or anonymised.
privacy.section.5.title: 5. Recipients and data processors
privacy.section.5.body:
We do not share your data with third parties except where legally required. This website checks the house's availability through the public Google Calendar API, which is only used to read an availability calendar; none of your personal data is sent to Google while browsing the website.

The site is hosted on GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc.), which acts as a data processor solely to serve the website's static files.
privacy.section.6.title: 6. Your rights
privacy.section.6.body: You can exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction and portability by writing to the contact email indicated in section 1. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (aepd.es) if you believe your data is not being processed correctly.
privacy.section.7.title: 7. Security measures
privacy.section.7.body: We apply reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your data against unauthorised access, loss or alteration, to the extent appropriate for a website of this nature.

meta.bookingTerms.description: Booking, payment and cancellation terms for Casa Rural Valle de Arbas.
bookingTerms.title: Booking and cancellation terms
bookingTerms.intro: A clear summary of how a booking at Casa Rural Valle de Arbas works, from start to finish. If you have any questions, contact us before confirming.
bookingTerms.section.1.title: 1. How to book
bookingTerms.section.1.body: The whole house is rented as one unit, with a minimum stay of two nights. We don't work with intermediaries: simulate your dates on the availability calendar, then message or call us (WhatsApp works too) to confirm the booking directly with us.
bookingTerms.section.2.title: 2. Check-in and check-out
bookingTerms.section.2.body: Check-in is from 17:00 and check-out before 12:00. We'll meet you at the door with the keys. Checking out later than 12:00 carries a €50 surcharge.
bookingTerms.section.3.title: 3. Occupancy
bookingTerms.section.3.body: The whole house sleeps up to 20 people.
bookingTerms.section.4.title: 4. Price and what's included
bookingTerms.section.4.body: The price includes the whole house and final cleaning.
bookingTerms.section.5.title: 5. Cancellation policy
bookingTerms.section.5.body: If you cancel more than a month before the check-in date, we'll refund the amount. If you cancel less than a month before, the €300 deposit is withheld.
bookingTerms.section.6.title: 6. House rules

meta.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
meta.faq.description: We answer the most common questions about the rural house in the Valle de Arbas: schedules, pets, cancellations and more.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Here we answer the most common questions before booking. If you have any other question, write to us and we'll be happy to help.
faq.q1.question: What are the check-in and check-out times?
faq.q1.answer: Check-in is from 17:00 and check-out before 12:00. We'll meet you at the door with the keys. Checking out later than 12:00 carries a €50 surcharge.
faq.q2.question: What's the minimum number of nights?
faq.q2.answer: The whole house is rented as one unit, with a minimum stay of two nights.
faq.q3.question: How many people fit in the house?
faq.q3.answer: The whole house sleeps up to 20 people.
faq.q4.question: Are pets allowed?
faq.q5.question: Is there wifi and heating?
faq.q5.answer: Yes: fibre wifi throughout the house and heating in every room.
faq.q6.question: Is there parking nearby?
faq.q6.answer: Yes, the house has private parking.
faq.q7.question: Is there a fireplace in the house?
faq.q7.answer: Yes, the house has two pellet stoves in the common areas, lit during the colder months.
faq.q8.question: How do I book, and what's the cancellation policy?
faq.q8.answer: We book with no intermediaries: simulate your dates on the calendar, then message or call us (WhatsApp works too) to confirm. If you cancel more than a month before the check-in date, we'll refund the amount; less than a month before, the €300 deposit is withheld.
